#### ClearAllCachesAsync

```text
public static System.Threading.Tasks.Task ClearAllCachesAsync(System.String tokenCachePath = default)
```

Clears the MSAL file-based token cache.

- Parameter `tokenCachePath`: Optional path to the token cache file. If null, uses the default global path. Pass a custom path when using isolated test directories to avoid clearing production cache.

Remarks: This method deletes the unprotected file-based token cache used by the CLI. The cache file location matches PPDS.Auth.Credentials.MsalClientBuilder.CreateAndRegisterCacheAsync(Microsoft.Identity.Client.IPublicClientApplication,System.Boolean).
